fields.statement: At 3e2f3f6b2: go test -trimpath ./internal/web -run TestLinksResolve -count=1 PASS (exit 0); go test -trimpath ./internal/web/... ok; rhiza ship generate and rhiza render exit 0 with no tracked changes. internal/web/links_test.go builds a two-project root (a, b) via RootWithProjects, each with a landed change set (intent, capability, decision) and a run, and crawls /p/<name>/ Home, /roadmap, /changes/<cs>, /runs/<run> and /nodes/links-cap, following every href/src/data-rz-fragment link: each in-project link must return 200, any link leaving the project fails unless it is a shared root path, and at least 8 pages must be crawled. Fakes only (no network, Rex or gh); diff touches only the test file plus actor log/rendered records; no stubs or TODOs.
